yacl:
  version: 1.1
  lang: auto

  params:
    min_keywords_per_set: 5
    glossary_lock_ja:
      "EVP": "価値提案（EVP）"
      "KPI": "成果指標（KPI）"

  flags:
    translate_to_inferred_locale: true
    prohibit_html_tags: true
    render_keyword_table_vertical: true
    boldify__all_keywords__strict: true
    enforce_parabreak_every__2_sentences: true
    opening_style__experiential__required: true
    require_all_keywords_in__introduction: true

  modes:
    extended_markdown:
      logic_flags:
        precedence: logic_flags_override_generic_flags

        force_gpt_to_translate_to_inferred_locale_when_lang_auto:
          strategy: majority_charcount
          cultural_term_override: true
          tiebreaker: prefer_japanese_when_mixed

        require_gpt_to_open_with_experiential_scene_element:
          min_experiential_sentences: 1
          must_include_sensory_or_action_cue: true

        require_gpt_to_include_all_keywords_naturally_with_semantics_preserved:
          allow_inflection_and_compounds: true
          forbid_semantic_shift: true
          forbid_plain_list_dump_in_intro: true

        require_gpt_to_define_keyword_categories_as_logical_facets:
          examples_allowed: ["メインキーワード","共起語","関連ワード"]
          min_categories: 3
          min_terms_per_category: ${params.min_keywords_per_set}

        enforce_parabreak_every_two_sentences_by_lang_delimiters:
          ja_sentence_delimiter: "。"
          en_sentence_delimiter: "."
          treat_semicolon_as_inline: true

        require_gpt_to_pair_glossary_lock_terms_with_original_and_translation_and_boldify:
          pair_original_and_translation: true
          boldify_all_locked_terms: true
          en_output_behavior: "pair_with_ja"

        force_gpt_to_render_vertical_keyword_table:
          rows: 3
          min_terms_each: ${params.min_keywords_per_set}

        force_gpt_to_output_sections_in_order_h1_title_keyword_table_intro: true

        failure_recovery:
          table_rendering:
            retry_order: ["vertical-strict","vertical-relaxed","horizontal"]
            vertical_relaxed_min_terms_each: 4
          language_flow:
            retry_if_lang_mismatch: true
            final_force_to_inferred_locale: true

  contract:
    format: extended_markdown_source
    sections_order__h1_title__keyword_table__intro: true
    rules:
      h1_title__display_topic_name__inferred_locale: true
      keyword_table__3_categories__>=5_terms_each: true
      intro__include_all_keywords__natural_flow: true

  assertions:
    h1_count__==1: true
    table_count__==1: true
    row_count_in_first_table__==3: true
    all_rows_have_at_least__${params.min_keywords_per_set}_terms: true
    no_html_tags_in_output: true
    lang__==inferred_locale: true

  notes:
    deprecation_plan_for_generic_flags: >
      従来の flags は後方互換のため当面維持するが、logic_flags への段階的吸収を前提とする。
      衝突時は logic_flags を優先し、将来的に従来 flags を削除する。

---

templates:

  extended_markdown/keyword_map_v1:
    description: "縦型キーワード表 + 体験的導入の基本プリセット"
    requires:
      core: "yacl.version >= 1.1"
    apply:
      use_logic_flags:
        - force_gpt_to_translate_to_inferred_locale_when_lang_auto
        - require_gpt_to_open_with_experiential_scene_element
        - require_gpt_to_define_keyword_categories_as_logical_facets
        - require_gpt_to_include_all_keywords_naturally_with_semantics_preserved
        - enforce_parabreak_every_two_sentences_by_lang_delimiters
        - force_gpt_to_render_vertical_keyword_table
        - require_gpt_to_pair_glossary_lock_terms_with_original_and_translation_and_boldify
        - force_gpt_to_output_sections_in_order_h1_title_keyword_table_intro
      params:
        min_keywords_per_set: 5

  extended_markdown/keyword_map_strict_v1:
    description: "英語出力時の対表記抑止・回復手順強化"
    requires:
      core: "yacl.version >= 1.1"
    apply:
      use_logic_flags:
        - force_gpt_to_translate_to_inferred_locale_when_lang_auto
        - require_gpt_to_open_with_experiential_scene_element
        - require_gpt_to_define_keyword_categories_as_logical_facets
        - require_gpt_to_include_all_keywords_naturally_with_semantics_preserved
        - enforce_parabreak_every_two_sentences_by_lang_delimiters
        - force_gpt_to_render_vertical_keyword_table
        - force_gpt_to_output_sections_in_order_h1_title_keyword_table_intro
      overrides:
        logic_flags:
          require_gpt_to_pair_glossary_lock_terms_with_original_and_translation_and_boldify:
            en_output_behavior: "suppress"
          failure_recovery:
            table_rendering:
              retry_order: ["vertical-strict","vertical-relaxed","horizontal"]
              vertical_relaxed_min_terms_each: 4
